zh: 既是真前缀又是真后缀的串叫作“边界”，所求就是整串最长真边界的长度，前后缀允许重叠。
KMP 的前缀函数在位置 i 的值，正是 s[0..i] 的最长真边界长度，所以答案就是前缀函数的最后一项，线性时间可得。
前缀函数首项为 0，用 j 表示当前已匹配的长度：对 i 从 1 到 n−1，当 j>0 且 s[i] 与 s[j] 不同时，令 j 退回到前缀函数在 j−1 处的值；若 s[i] 与 s[j] 相同则 j 加一；把 j 记为位置 i 的值。输出最后一项。长度可达 10^6，用紧凑的整数数组和快速读入。
en: A string that is both a proper prefix and a proper suffix is called a border; the task asks for the length of the longest proper border of the whole string, and the prefix and suffix may overlap.
The KMP prefix function at position i is exactly the length of the longest proper border of s[0..i], so the answer is its last entry, computed in linear time.

The prefix function starts with 0; let j be the current matched length. For i from 1 to n−1: while j>0 and s[i] differs from s[j], set j to the prefix function value at j−1; if s[i] equals s[j], increase j; store j as the value at i. Print the last value. The length can reach 10^6, so use a compact integer array and fast input.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Compute the KMP prefix function; its last entry is the length of the longest proper border of the whole string.

## Correctness

At each position, the prefix function records the longest proper border of the prefix ending at that position. On a mismatch, the only possible fallback is to a shorter border of the already matched prefix, and following this chain of candidates exhausts every possibility, so the final entry is exactly what is asked.

## Complexity

Time O(N), space O(N), using a compact integer array.
